Thank you for downloading the LBP English patch for Tales of Phantasia X!
If you are new to patching roms and/or emulating, this guide is for you! :D

Here's what you'll need in order to play:

- A rip of the UMD version of Narikiri Dungeon X (the PSN version will not work)
- The patches and software in this folder
- Either a soft modded PSP or PS Vita/PS TV or anything that can run the PPSSPP emulator

Steps to follow:

1. To begin click the application called xdeltaUI. This will bring up a window.
   At the top you will see a box called "patch" and to the right a button that says "open."
   Click it and navigate to where you have the patch stored, highlight it and select "open".

2. Next, the box below that one says "source file". Select open and navigate to where your NDX
   rom is stored and highlight and open.

3. At the bottom is a box that says "output file". This step will be a little different.
   You want to type out the name of what you want the patched rom to be called and make sure that
   at the end of the name you put ".iso" (without the quotes)

4. Click "patch" and let it do its work.

5. Once it tells you that the file has been patched successfully, you will have a functioning
   english patched rom in the folder with everything else. Cut and paste it where it needs to go!

Setting up PPSSPP is really pretty simple. We have a link to the dev builds for it in the "How to
fix graphics" text file. At this point you'll want to unzip and launch the software (the exe you
want to launch is the one with 64 in the name) and bind your controls (in Settings / Controls /
Control mapping). You might also want to go to Graphics and set the Rendering resolution to "1x PSP"
and set the Screen scaling filter to Nearest (under Settings / Graphics / Display Layout & effects)
and maybe also enable Auto frameskip to help with the battle swirl effect causing some slowdown.
